description_en: Updates the status of log delivery
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem update-data-storage-delivery --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --log-code aegis-log-login --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateDataStorageDelivery

parameters.help_en:
The region where the Data Management hub for Threat Analysis is located. Select the region of the management hub based on the region of your asset. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Your asset is in the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: Your asset is in a region outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response message. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese.

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The status of log delivery. Valid values:

enable: Enables log delivery.

disable: Disables log delivery
parameters.help_zh:
日志投递状态。取值：
enable：开通投递。
disable：关闭投递
parameters.name: log_delivery_status

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the member. This parameter is used when an administrator switches to the perspective of a member
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for
